entities.name: Ignacio Ortíz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ignacio Horacio Ortiz is an Argentine field hockey player who plays as a midfielder for Banco Provincia. He competed in the field hockey competition at the 2016 Summer Olympics, where he won the gold medal. He played club hockey for Real Club de Polo de Barcelona in Spain.
